name: iCloud Mail (read only)
description: Your iCloud inbox over IMAP, read only: how many messages and how many unread, and the sender, subject and date of the newest few. An example of a protocol adapter with a kept credential: Valet signs in with your app-specific password and opens INBOX read-only, so nothing is marked read, and the tool code never sees the password or any message body.

mail.description: Your iCloud email address and an app-specific password (account.apple.com, Sign-In and Security, App-Specific Passwords)

tools.name: inbox_overview
tools.title: Inbox overview
tools.description: How many messages your iCloud inbox holds and how many are unread. Reads nothing else.

tools.name: recent_mail
tools.title: Recent mail
tools.description: The newest messages in your iCloud inbox (at most 10): each one's sender address, subject, date and whether you've read it. Never the body, and nothing is marked read.
